title: Implement authoritative Farm photo-pressure aggregation
verify: Independent verification proves one Farm-scoped SUM over authoritative Photo Catalog size_bytes, exact strict threshold behavior, archived retention, cross-Farm isolation, named exclusions, and safe database failure without disk scan.
evidence_required: FT-015-AC-005 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: no Farm photo-pressure query/service exists, so the accepted result cannot be invoked before its task-owned read projection is created; alternative proof: preflight absence plus GREEN empty/209715199/209715200/209715201, cross-Farm, archived-retained, and database-failure matrix; decisive comparison: returned total and eligibility against authoritative catalog fixtures; artifact: focused pytest transcript under .tasks/TASK-065-T2-FT-015-W1/.
purpose: Create the single Photo-Intake-owned read projection that calculates prompt eligibility from accepted original photo metadata without scanning storage or creating prompt state.
success_outcome: An internal Farm-scoped service returns accepted_original_photo_bytes and prompt_eligible from COALESCE(SUM(photo_catalog_items.size_bytes),0), counts each catalog row once, includes retained archived-Plant photos, and fails closed on database error.
anti_goals: Do not add an HTTP route, prompt interaction, table/migration, filesystem scanner, Timeline event, or UI code.
Do not count manifests, database size, logs, cache/temp/orphans, exports/derivatives, screenshots/assets, or Dataset refs.
constraints: Aggregate only authoritative PhotoCatalogItem.size_bytes filtered by farm_id.
Use constant 209715200 and strict greater-than; equality is false.
Repository owns the query; service owns the result policy. No transport behavior in this task.
invariants: Every accepted photo contributes once and only once.
Filesystem contents and duplicate refs cannot influence the result.
Archive is retention, not storage deletion.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-005: focused repository/service matrix proves exact totals, threshold, Farm isolation, archived retention, exclusions by query shape, and fail-closed database behavior.

forbidden_scope: HTTP/API/OpenAPI, frontend, migrations, artifact deletion, Dataset lifecycle, Timeline, or remote sync.
stop_conditions: The accepted total cannot be derived solely from Photo Catalog size_bytes.
Implementation requires a new persistence model, migration, disk scanner, or product decision.
